decisions.decision: Entity-Component composition: Entity has List<IComponent>, systems query components
decisions.rationale: Lightweight, no ECS framework dependency, sufficient for scope.

decisions.decision: System font rendering via content pipeline (.spritefont) using Arial size 24
decisions.rationale: MonoGame's SpriteFont provides efficient glyph rendering. Arial size 24 fits 32px tiles.

decisions.decision: Tiles rendered as colored rectangle background (15% alpha) + glyph character centered via DrawString
decisions.rationale: Provides clear roguelike aesthetic with visible glyph shapes on colored tile backgrounds.

decisions.decision: Pinned MonoGame NuGet packages to 3.8.2.1105 for content pipeline compatibility
decisions.rationale: MonoGame 3.8.4.1 dotnet-mgcb tool has assembly resolution issue with FontDescription type.

decisions.decision: Game1.Instance singleton for scene management access from scenes
decisions.rationale: Enables scenes to push/pop transitions (e.g., stairs -> placeholder, game over -> title) without tight coupling.

decisions.decision: Movement uses keyboard state polling per frame with prev-state edge detection for Enter key
decisions.rationale: Simple polling approach sufficient for turn-based movement. Enter requires edge detection to avoid multiple triggers.

decisions.decision: Stair interaction pushes PlaceholderScene onto the scene stack
decisions.rationale: Lightweight mechanism for scene transitions. PlaceholderScene pops itself on Enter, returning to the overworld.

notes: Phase 5 complete. Player can move with WASD/Arrow keys, camera follows, walls block movement, stairs trigger scene transitions. Title and GameOver screens implemented. Game starts at title screen. 132 tests pass (0 failures).
